audit.whatIsWrong: All 7 phases[N].side read the placeholder 'Skill' instead of a champion name, while content win[0-6] already correctly names Rakan favoured in every stage.
audit.why: The verdict itself isn't changing — content's early/mid/late prose already argues Rakan wins every stage (Tahm has no dash to punish the W engage, no lockdown, stays reactive). Per the chart rule, when win[N] already states the target side, only the placeholder side field needs fixing — the why text already argues for Rakan in every row, so it needs no rewrite.
Spikes at Lvl 2 (W knock-up before 3-stack Tongue Lash), Lvl 6 (charm forces a defensive Devour), and 1st item (E-dash kiting since Tahm has no dash) are grounded in the kits.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Abyssal Dive as matchup-defining but has no digits, and content mislabels Devour as '(W)' twice when it is actually Tahm's R (W is Abyssal Dive per enemyAbilities).
audit.why: Abyssal Dive (W) is 21/20/19/18/17 by rank. Devour is the R slot, gated by 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste rather than a fixed cooldown (kit lists cd 0). Calling it '(W)' twice misidentifies the ability a reader would look for on the loading screen.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns rewritten with real numbers; the two '(W)' mislabels of Devour corrected to '(R)'.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive: matchup-defining — His re-engage and his escape — all-in only while it is down. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your E Battle Dance answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench Abyssal Dive cools 21s at rank 1, down to 17s at 5 — his re-engage and his escape, so all-in only while it is down. - Battle Dance (E) has no cooldown — reposition freely. - Devour (R) gates on 3 stacks of An Acquired Taste, not a timer.

edits.before: Q the pair for the heal, W the window, E home — the trade paid twice and answered once.
edits.after: Chain Q into W while Abyssal Dive is down — he has no other gap-closer to punish the commit.

edits.before: Entrancing into a banked disengage — the bird that flies into tornadoes writes the highlight for the other team.
edits.after: Battle Dance needs a return body — hop without one and you land stranded in his Tongue Lash range.

edits.before: The Quickness (R) charm engage forces Tahm to burn Devour (W) to save his ADC — if he eats his carry defensively you've still won the fight tempo, and if he doesn't, you kill it.
edits.after: The Quickness (R) charm engage forces Tahm to burn Devour (R) to save his ADC — if he eats his carry defensively you've still won the fight tempo, and if he doesn't, you kill it.

edits.before: Devour (W) his ADC to negate your engage, then peel
edits.after: Devour (R) his ADC to negate your engage, then peel

notes: Main defect was the level chart carrying the 'Skill' placeholder instead of the champion name on all 7 rows while content already had the correct Rakan verdict throughout — fixed as a same-verdict side-only flip per the chart rule, no why rewrites needed since existing why text already argued for Rakan. Also caught and fixed a real ability-slot error the lint didn't flag: Devour is Tahm's R, not W (W is Abyssal Dive) — mislabeled twice in content.
